The rules below are the locked mobile-hardening minimums; 0 fails is the pass mark.

signedIn.$comment: Follow-up 5 of PR 85 — the signed-in run (--email/--password-file) on a database seeded with the sample catalogue (packages/seed sample, rules sample, combos sample: sample data only, never the owner's). Every lighthouserc path plus `urls` is opened with the session, except `signedOutPaths`. `discover` opens a page and adds the first `take` links its selector finds (required: none found fails the run). `expect` (per path, or per discover entry) lists the controls that only show with data; a page without them fails as CONTROL-MISSING, so the gate never passes on an empty page.
